pageDescription: Access liquidity from your native assets without selling or giving up control of your holdings.
borrowSubheading: Use your {{collateralAsset}} as collateral with transparent rates, fair liquidations, and full control of your assets.
invalidDebtRemaining: Cannot withdraw collateral while debt is still outstanding.
liquidationPriceNotApplicable: Position will be paid off, liquidation price not applicable
feesTooltip: Fees shown when withdrawing assets from Rujira include the Rujira network fee and the withdrawal fee charged by the destination network. The destination network fee may vary based on network activity.
collateralRatioTooltip: The multiplier applied to {{symbol}}'s price to determine how much collateral value it provides when borrowing.
adjustedCollateralValueTooltip: The value of your {{symbol}} collateral used to calculate your loan-to-value ratio.
interestRateTooltip: Dynamic yearly interest rate that increases or decreases based on borrowing demand and available liquidity.
ltvTooltip: Adjusted Loan-to-Value (LTV) is the ratio of your borrowed value to your adjusted collateral value.
liquidationPriceTooltip: The {{symbol}} price at which your position will be partially liquidated.
liquidationPriceTableTooltip: The price at which your position will be partially liquidated. For positions with multiple collaterals, hover the aggregated value to see the detail per collateral.
adjustedLtvTooltip: Adjusted Loan-to-Value (LTV) shows how close the position is to liquidation. At 100%, part of your position will be liquidated.
excessRepaymentWarning: You are trying to repay more than your outstanding debt. Excess repayment will be available as collateral in your Credit Account.
perTokenLiquidationPriceNote: Assumes all collateral prices fall by the same percentage while debt prices stay unchanged.
